messages:
ashley (oncall): :rotating_light: getting a spike of auth 500s from na-central1 control plane, console shows config rollout stuck at 47% and session-store errors
ben (infra): saw the same in metrics — auth token service 504s, Redis connection errors, and several kube-proxy restarts on the controlplane nodes
ashley (oncall): noticed a handful of GPU worker pods getting evicted around the same time, curious if controlplane issues are triggering node churn
ben (infra): checking ETCD health -> 3/5 members reporting high RTT, leader election flapping. disk i/o on cp-03 is high, possibly networked disk issue
marta (prod-eng): is there a safe way to pause the config rollout? we should stop new config pushes until we stabilize the control plane
ashley (oncall): agreed — pausing rollout now via console (if it stays reachable). if console dies, use API fallback
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2025-4319 | Region: na-central1 | Impact: control plane auth + routing degraded | severity: high
leo (networking): routing shows packet drops to cp subnet from the internal LB; suspect a partial blackhole in the region's spine. starting to shift non-critical traffic routing out of na-central1
ben (infra): preparing a gradual traffic shift. plan: reduce router weight to na-central1 to 20% over 5m, increase west2 to compensate. pushing now:
```
# decrease weight for na-central1
rctl routing set-weight --route controlplane-api --region na-central1 --weight 0.2
# increase west2
rctl routing set-weight --route controlplane-api --region west2 --weight 0.8
```
ben (infra): also initiating etcd snapshot restore test on a standby cp node and marking cp-03 for maintenance (drain + disk checks)
marta (prod-eng): coordinating with customers — sending brief status update to affected tenants and opening follow-up threads for dedicated clusters
ashley (oncall): console latency jumped but still responsive for now; pausing rollout succeeded. monitoring auth 5xx rate and KV latency
leo (networking): traffic shift started, SYN retransmits dropping by ~40% so far. continuing shift, will keep weight stepdown every 2m
ben (infra): cp-03 IO queue depth still high after drain, suspect underlying host storage issue. ops ticket to cloud provider opened (case CP-98721)
marta (prod-eng): reminder — if we end up failing over control plane entirely, rollback plan is documented in runbook under /runbooks/controlplane-failover. we should prep the DB failover checklist now
ashley (oncall): timeline note: root msg 1765432100, shift started at 1765432280. will update with next status in 5m
sre-bot: update: traffic shift 30% complete -> na-central1 at 20% weight. alarms suppressed for planned remediation
ben (infra): next steps: confirm etcd quorum stable on remaining members, replace cp-03 storage, rejoin after CI health checks. also run a targeted cache warm for auth tokens to reduce backend hits
leo (networking): continuing to watch for cross-region latency increase; early signs look OK. will keep routes pinned until cp performance steady
ashley (oncall): thanks all — we're in mitigation (traffic shifted, rollout paused, maintenance in progress). tagging oncall rotation for next hour.
